name: XAU_PHENOMENON_ATLAS_V1
notes: Quintile cutpoints are fit on 2024 only and frozen into 2025.
All future-label windows must remain contiguous M5 bars; labels do not jump across news-excluded gaps.
Tests compare each state with its same-year complement.
BH correction is applied separately within each outcome/horizon family.
No PnL, stop, target, position sizing or execution optimization is permitted in Phase I-C.
A survivor is a phenomenon candidate only, not a trading strategy.
